entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: Daughter of daimyo Konda and Yoshino; later joined with Kyodai as the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: Daimyo whose crime started the Kami War.

entities.name: Yoshino
entities.description: Michiko's mother, who died in childbirth.

entities.name: Choryu
entities.description: Friend who helped Michiko escape Eiganjo.

entities.name: Toshi Umezawa
entities.description: Shadow-walker hired by Michiko who repeatedly saved her.

entities.name: Sharp-Ear
entities.description: Kami whose trickery foiled the Minamo plan.

entities.name: That Which Was Taken
entities.description: Entity captured by Konda, freed by Michiko and renamed Kyodai.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: Michiko's spirit sister, child of O-Kagachi.

entities.name: Sisters of Flesh and Spirit
entities.description: Merged form of Michiko and Kyodai, new guardians of Kamigawa.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: Great kami destroyed by the Sisters.

entities.name: Myojin of Life's Web
entities.description: Kami from whose wrath Toshi saved Michiko.

events.summary: Michiko's mother dies in childbirth; Konda neglects his daughter, leaving her with Lady Pearl-Ear.
Choryu helps Michiko escape Eiganjo; she meets Toshi Umezawa in Jukai, who saves her from the Myojin of Life's Web.
events.quote: After saving her from the wrath of the Myojin of Life's Web

events.summary: Michiko and her party are at Minamo during Hidetsugu's attack and Toshi saves them.
events.quote: Once again, Toshi Umezawa saved her and her friends.

events.summary: Michiko shatters the disk, freeing the Taken One, who becomes Kyodai; they merge into the Sisters and destroy O-Kagachi.
Kyodai punishes Konda; the sisters become the new guardians of Kamigawa.
events.quote: Kyodai later punished Konda for his crime as well.

events.summary: Michiko uncovers the real cause of the Kami War with Kyodai's support, facing opposition.
events.quote: she made the bold choice to uncover the real cause behind the Kami War for all to see

events.summary: The Sisters order Leshrac Nightwalker to leave their plane.
events.quote: the Sisters stood in his way and ordered him to go away from their plane

events.summary: Michiko is posthumously styled the first emperor of a new Kamigawa.
events.quote: styling her as the first emperor of a new Kamigawa

relations.quote: a daughter of daimyo Konda and lady Yoshino
Toshi allowed himself to be hired by the princess
leaving her under the tutelage of Lady Pearl-Ear
